reason: A DSH interface plugin that adds a confirmed, permanent session-deletion action and cleans related session metadata and caches.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 会话菜单添加带二次确认的永久删除功能，并清理相关持久化文件、工作区记录和缓存。
summaries.en: Adds a confirmed permanent-delete action to DSH session menus and cleans related persistence files, workspace records, and caches.

capabilities: Adds a delete action to session menus
Displays confirmation dialogs and handles duplicate session names
Removes session references from workspace and archive metadata
Refreshes the session list through host events and client refreshes
